title: Towards Equal Opportunity Fairness through Adversarial Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap in a sentiment analysis classification task (MOJI dataset) between tweets exhibiting African American English (AAE) and Standard American English (SAE).
Evaluating the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap and RMS TPR gap across binary gender labels in an occupation classification task (BIOS dataset).

Measuring the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap across economic status groups (wealthy vs. rest, based on country location) in an occupation classification task (BIOS dataset), evaluated as an intersectional class with gender.
